newsitem.title: USA: MGE spring wheat ends lower amid hedge pressure.
newsitem.headline: MGE spring wheat ends lower amid hedge pressure.

text.p: MGE spring wheat futures ended lower as both the March and December contracts were hit by hedge pressure tied to an increase in country movement, traders said.
"We had overhead selling that I would attribute to elevator-type hedging. That kept us from going anywhere," an MGE trader said.
Traders also reported seeing steady commercial spreading throughout the session. The December/March spread traded between 15 and 16 cents throughout the session, and closed being offered at 16 cents.
MGE spring wheat closed 1-1/4 to 4-3/4 cents per bushel lower, with Dec down 4-1/4 cents at $4.04-3/4. March shed 4-1/4 cents to close at $4.04-3/4.
Traders also reported seeing some continued buying in the March contract connected to export business announced earlier this week.
Traders said Wilson and LFG each bought 1.5 million March bushels. Country Hedging sold 300,000 March bushels and 500,000 Dec. Atwood-Peavey sold 800,000 March and 400,000 Dec.
MGE barley futures closed six cents per cwt lower to four cents higher, with Dec up four cents at $6.75.
